crossRefs.note: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”
translations.bsb: but Eli called to him and said, “Samuel, my son.” “Here I am,” answered Samuel.
translations.kjv: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.
translations.asv: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he said, Here am I.
